help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Frequently asked questions about using Kaarya.
help.postTask: How do I post a task?
help.postTaskAnswer: Go to the Home tab and tap 'Post a Task'. Fill in the details — title, description, budget, and location. Your task will be visible to nearby service providers who can then send you offers.
help.acceptOffer: How do I accept an offer?
help.acceptOfferAnswer: When a provider sends you an offer, you'll see it on your task's detail page. You can review their profile, rating, and message them to discuss before accepting. Tap 'Accept' to assign the task to them.
help.getPaidAnswer: Payment integration (eSewa, Khalti) is coming soon. Once available, you'll be able to link your eSewa or Khalti account and receive payments directly after completing a task.
help.verificationAnswer: Go to your Profile and tap 'Verification'. Choose the Manual Review option, upload a clear photo of your citizenship card (front and back) along with a selfie. Your documents will be reviewed within 12 hours.
help.switchRole: How do I switch between roles?
help.switchRoleAnswer: On your Profile screen, use the role switcher at the top. You can switch between Task Poster (to post jobs) and Service Provider (to bid on jobs) anytime. Your mode affects what you see on the Home and Browse tabs.
help.deleteAccount: How do I delete my account?
help.deleteAccountAnswer: Account deletion is not yet available in the app. If you need your account deleted, please contact our support team and we will assist you.
help.note: More help topics and live support coming soon.
help.cantFindAnswer: Can't find what you're looking for?
help.cantFindAnswerSub: Send us an email and our team will get back to you shortly.
